systems.name: 7.1 Playtesting & Balance
systems.notes: Internal and external playtesting. Tune enemy HP, damage, drop rates, co‑op scaling. Ensure all difficulty modes are fair.
tasks: Collect feedback on combat feel, progression pace
Adjust weapon and horn power balance
Ensure Story Mode is forgiving, Mythical is challenging

systems.name: 7.2 Bug Fixing & QA
systems.notes: Fix all known bugs: collision, save corruption, co‑op desyncs, UI glitches.
tasks: Create bug tracker and prioritise issues
Test all controller types and keyboard layouts

systems.name: 7.3 Packaging & Distribution
systems.notes: Prepare game for release on itch.io, possibly Steam. Create store page, trailer, press kit.
tasks: Export final build (Windows, Mac, Linux, Web?)
Set up itch.io page with screenshots
Write press release and community announcement

systems.name: 7.4 Post‑Launch Support
systems.notes: Plan for seasonal events, new cosmetics, enemy variants, and community feedback.
tasks: Engage with player community on Discord
